text:
Sam: Quick sync — we need a concise, product-friendly roadmap for the 'compact policy' routing + multi-region tenancy work. Two big customer asks (Acme Health, BeaconFin): region isolation + per-tenant KMS. Cost delta vs soft isolation looks significant. Need launch criteria, migration pattern, and suggested tradeoffs. Can infra/product list ownership + rough ETA?
Jia: +1. I'll draft a policy matrix: isolation level vs SLA vs cost. Want to see numbers for p50/p95 latency degradation when enabling tenant-slicing vs baseline.
Omar: Important: affinity affects cache hit rates — per-tenant pools will hurt KV/prefix cache efficiency. We should quantify token cost and latency tail penalty.
Lina: Proposal: 3-phase rollout: 1) baseline policy flavors + defaults (soft isolation, tenant-sliced, strict isolation), 2) pilot with 2 customers (Acme Health + BeaconFin), 3) GA with contracts and pricing tiers. Gate: telemetry for cross-tenant latency and verified regional failover.
Matt: Dependencies: routing rule orchestration, billing/tagging work, KMS per-tenant integration, and console exposure. Who owns the orchestration plumbing? @Sam? Need preliminary ETA for Q3 vs Q4.
Sam: I can own policy design and product docs. @Jia will own perf numbers. @Omar owns runtime changes. @Lina you own rollout checklist and pilot coordination.
Jia: For perf numbers, I need synthetic workloads + a couple of anonymized real traces. Can SRE/observability surface per-tenant cache hit and p99 tail for a pilot?
Omar: We can run a canary with tenant-slicing on a small pool. Risk: cross-tenant batch merging in async path — need explicit opt-out flag for privacy-sensitive tenants.
Lina: Suggested launch criteria to debate: 1) region failover validated < 30s, 2) p99 latency penalty < 15% for tenant-sliced vs baseline, 3) per-tenant billing accuracy validated within 0.5%, 4) key-per-tenant KMS working in staging, 5) rollout playbook and rollback procedures documented.
Sam: +1 on those. Add rollback triggers — sustained error rate >0.5% for 5m OR cost delta >30% during pilot.
Matt: Legal/compliance note: Acme Health requires SOC2 addendum + data residency attestation. Flagging @legal-ops for contract language.
infra-bot: deploy-link: https://deploys.redwood/perm-1723 (automated canary scheduled) :robot_face:
Jia: I'll assemble the matrix and a simple calc sheet (cost vs isolation vs perf) and post by EOD tomorrow.
Omar: Quick heads-up from runtime emulation: strict per-tenant pools show ~22% token cost increase on bursty workloads due to lost batching. I'll drop the spreadsheet link here once cleaned.
Lina: Requesting a 2-week spike to implement routing policy hooks + telemetry events. If SRE can allocate 2 engineers for the spike, we'll validate metrics and produce the perf baseline.
Sam: Approved spike. @sre-team can you assign resources? Also need a doc owner for the external FAQ and migration guide.
Matt: I'll draft the dependency tracker and update the roadmap doc. Tentative plan: spike in Sprint 12, pilot in Sprint 14, GA in Sprint 20, adjust as needed based on spike outcomes.
Sam: Next steps recap: @Jia perf sheet, @Omar runtime spike, @Lina rollout checklist + pilot plan, @Matt roadmap + deps, docs owner TBD. Meeting Friday 10am to review spike findings and sign off.
Lina: 10am works for me. I'll create the calendar invite and add a short agenda (metrics to show, pilot customers, rollback criteria).
Sam: Thanks all :thumbsup:
